conditions.displayName: The provider breaker opened after consecutive upstream model failures

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="whim-server" AND logName:"run.googleapis.com%2Fstdout" AND jsonPayload.msg="provider breaker open"

documentation.content: The AI provider is failing: several model calls in a row failed on the provider's side (a 5xx, a rate limit, a network error or a timeout), so generate, clarify and rewrite are refusing with `provider_unavailable` until a probe succeeds. At most one email per hour: read `errorKind` and `status` on the `provider breaker open` line, check https://status.openrouter.ai, and see docs/deploy.md, Operating: Alerts.
